title: Quasi-compact scheme
statement: A topological space $T$ is *quasi-compact* if every open covering of $T$ has a finite subcovering (no Hausdorff condition). A scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] is *quasi-compact* if its underlying topological space is quasi-compact.
